facts.fact: Heirs Technologies report says Microsoft Azure has Cape Town and Johannesburg cloud regions, dated 2019.
Heirs Technologies report says AWS has a Cape Town cloud region, dated 2020.
Heirs Technologies report says Google Cloud opened its first African cloud region in Johannesburg in January 2024.
Heirs Technologies report names Teraco in Johannesburg and Cape Town among Africa's first hyperscale data centres, operating; no opening date given so report date 2025-11 is used.

systems.system: NTT Global Data Centers South Africa

note: 49 South African data centres is an aggregator count with no hire or certification distinction, so not a fact; Tier III mentions concern Nigeria.
